analysis:
The PR changes only docs/reference/model-registry-format.md: it bumps the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and, at head lines 120-124, documents that on macOS the post-download aggregate weight hash reads each file uncached, with a reader thread one chunk ahead of the hash (OverlappedFileDigest.swift), before PageCache drops the file's pages. No executable code, authentication, key handling, coordinator or provider trust-boundary behavior, or manifest/registration validation rules change in the supplied evidence. The rest of the document is unchanged apart from the line-number shift.

Relevant threat context: T-012 and T-027 cover weight substitution and integrity, and TB-002 covers model delivery. The documented hash contract is unchanged: each accepted file must still match its manifest size and SHA-256, and the aggregate hash must still match the catalog weight_hash. The doc change describes an overlapped read pipeline. If the implementation had a concurrency or ordering bug in the digest, it could weaken post-download verification (a hash-integrity question for T-012/T-027). That implementation (OverlappedFileDigest.swift, WeightHasher.swift) is not in the supplied evidence, so I cannot verify that the doc matches the code or that the digest is computed correctly. I record this as an unverified contract for a code-level pass, not as a finding. The page-cache-drop claim has a possible residual-data aspect (T-028 style) but concerns only file cache residency, not secrets.

No new attack surface or invalidated assumptions are identified from this doc-only change.
